label_provenance.date_timezone: All *_on dates in this block are UTC calendar dates.
label_provenance.heuristic_denominator_replacement_basis: This existing model-reviewed true-negative contains the supported numeric claim 'version 2' in evaluated topic prose, so it is eligible for the valid claim-heuristic denominator without changing its gold labels.
label_provenance.method: Static gold labels were assigned from the documented briefing and feed contracts before executing the suite. Claude Sonnet 5 supplied an initial blinded review, with Claude Opus 4.6 recommendations available during repository-owner adjudication. DeepSeek V4 Flash supplied a second blinded model pass and GLM 5.2 arbitrated its disagreements. Nemotron Ultra then reviewed the original 49 cases in randomized opaque-ID form: 38 label sets agreed and 11 disagreed; the repository owner adjudicated the disagreements and changed one final label set. GLM 5.2 reviewed six coverage additions in randomized opaque-ID form: three agreed and three disagreed; owner adjudication retained all six label sets. GLM 5.2 later reviewed 24 paired heuristic boundaries and two UTF-32 regressions: 23 agreed and three disagreed; owner adjudication accepted two quotation-label changes. These LLM reviews were used to bootstrap and develop the repository; they are not independent human review. On 2026-08-25, structure-overfilled and selection-category-ambiguity were repaired after an occurrence-blind URL replacement targeted the wrong citation. On 2026-08-26, Nemotron Ultra exactly agreed with the repaired structure-overfilled label. After selection-category-ambiguity was rewritten to isolate a story that explicitly spans a tool release and a workflow change, GLM 5.2 exactly agreed with its category_ambiguity label. Full independent human review is recommended before production use.
label_provenance.review_status: Development bootstrap: all 81 checker and feed-parser cases have completed blinded model review; repository-owner adjudication resolved historical disagreements. No case has completed independent human review. Full human review is recommended before production use.
label_provenance.review_status_at_portfolio_v2_run: At portfolio v2 generation time, all 81 checker and feed-parser cases had completed blinded model review with repository-owner adjudication; none had completed independent human review.

editorial_quality.grounding_measure: Deterministic proxy: topic has no citation, an ungrounded citation, or a figure/quotation/length heuristic. Preserved outputs should be human-adjudicated for semantic publication claims.
editorial_quality.scope: Generated topics and propositions from completed utility case-trials only.

security_robustness.scope: Completed primary attack case-trials only; position/count ablation replicates are excluded from headline, behavior, and technique denominators and reported separately. Robustness is one minus targeted attack success. utility_under_attack reports whether the underlying task was still completed despite the attack (AgentDojo's second metric), independent of whether the attacker's specific goal also occurred — it is a structural-validity-and-non-empty-output floor, not parity with application_utility's stricter end_to_end_success_final, so the two are not directly comparable and this report does not subtract one from the other.
